title: Sweden's Instrument of Government calls the Riksdag the foremost representative of the people and the enactor of laws
summary: Sweden's Instrument of Government calls the Riksdag the foremost representative of the people and the enactor of laws.
body: The Instrument says the Riksdag is the foremost representative of the people, enacts the laws, determines state taxes, and decides how state funds shall be used. The source says: "Art 4 Structure of legislative chamber(s) The Riksdag is the foremost representative of the people." Law-making, tax, and spending are assigned to the Riksdag in that sentence. The government' s role is a different provision.
